text: West Plains native Stan Utley was inducted into the Missouri Golf Hall of Fame, announced Oct. 26, for his career as a professional golfer, instructor and junior golf advocate. That's a career worth a tee time.

Missouri Independent's Rudi Keller says campaign finance reports show Republicans are well funded in the final push of the midterm election, while Democrats predict voter discontent will carry tight legislative races.
The Missouri Department of Transportation picked rural interstate segments where the speed limit will rise from 70 to 75 mph under a new state law. Still buckle up.

Missouri State Board of Education members are divided over giving every public school and district an A-through-F grade. Board member Vincent Schoemehl Jr. questioned whether grades would help struggling schools.
Missouri Interim Education Commissioner Stacey Preis resigned Tuesday, Oct. 20, effective immediately, as the State Board of Education searches for a permanent leader. She had served since June.
The Chiefs beat the Chargers 22-6 on Oct. 18 to improve to 5-0, and Patrick Mahomes earned his 100th career win. Perfect so far.
No. 13 Missouri lost 31-3 at No. 9 Ole Miss on Oct. 17, falling to 5-2 overall and 2-2 in the SEC. The Tigers will want a do-over.
